} } const order=[]; while(heap.length>0){ const top=heap[0]; const last=heap.pop(); if(heap.length>0){ heap[0]=last; let i=0; for(;;){ const l=2*i+1, r=l+1; let m=i; if(l<heap.length && less(heap[l],heap[m])) m=l; const color=new Map(); const pos=new Map(); const path=[]; function dfs(v){ color.set(v,1); pos.set(v,path.length); path.push(v); const succ=adj.get(v); let found=null; succ.forEach(function(a){ if(found) return; if(indeg.get(a)!==0) return; if(color.get(a)===1){ found=path.slice(pos.get(a)).concat(a); } else if(color.get(a)!==2){ found=dfs(a); } }); if(found) return found; path.pop(); pos.delete(v); color.set(v,2); return null; } let cyc=null; for(let i=0;i<nodes.length && !cyc;i++){ const v=nodes[i]; if(indeg.get(v)>0 && color.get(v)!==2){ cyc=dfs(v); } } return {order:[], cycle:cyc?cyc:[]}; }

newFinalArtifact.artifact: function plan(nodes, edges){var a=nodes||[],e=edges||[],i;var idx=new Map();for(i=0;i<a.length;i++)idx.set(a[i],i);var adj=new Map(),ind=new Map();for(i=0;i<a.length;i++){adj.set(a[i],[]);ind.set(a[i],0);}var seen=new Set();for(i=0;i<e.length;i++){var ed=e[i];if(!ed||!idx.has(ed[0])||!idx.has(ed[1]))continue;var key=ed[0]+'\u0000'+ed[1];if(seen.has(key))continue;seen.add(key);adj.get(ed[0]).push(ed[1]);ind.set(ed[1],ind.get(ed[1])+1);}var ready=[],done=new Set();for(i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(ind.get(a[i])===0)ready.push(a[i]);var order=[];while(ready.length){var best=0;for(i=1;i<ready.length;i++)if(idx.get(ready[i])<idx.get(ready[best]))best=i;var v=ready.splice(best,1)[0];done.add(v);order.push(v);var outs=adj.get(v);for(i=0;i<outs.length;i++){var w=outs[i];ind.set(w,ind.get(w)-1);if(ind.get(w)===0)ready.push(w);}}if(order.length===a.length)return{order:order,cycle:[]};var left=[];for(i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(!done.has(a[i]))left.push(a[i]);var ls=new Set(left);var color=new Map(),stack=[],cyc=null;function dfs(start){var st=[{node:start,it:0}];color.set(start,1);stack.push(start);while(st.length){var top=st[st.length-1];var outs=adj.get(top.node);if(top.it<outs.length){var w=outs[top.it++];if(!ls.has(w))continue;var c=color.get(w)||0;if(c===1){var pos=stack.lastIndexOf(w);cyc=stack.slice(pos).concat([w]);return;}if(c===0){color.set(w,1);stack.push(w);st.push({node:w,it:0});}}else{color.set(top.node,2);stack.pop();st.pop();}}}for(i=0;i<left.length;i++){if((color.get(left[i])||0)===0){dfs(left[i]);if(cyc)break;}}return{order:[],cycle:cyc||[]};}

oldArtifact.artifact: 按下季度预计40%新用户、60%老用户构成，A版本标准化成功率约84.0%，高于B版本约78.7%，建议下季度优先发布A。现状合并成功率A约82.7%、B约83.8%，B略高，但该口径受两版本用户结构差异影响，不宜直接作为下季度预期。两版本并非随机分配，新老用户构成差异明显，现有数据只能作描述性比较，不能认定A或B对成功率存在因果效果。如需因果结论，应通过随机对照或分层均衡采集验证。

newArtifact.artifact: 本版仅依据现有两版本数据做描述性比较。总体成功率：A为81/90与192/240合计273/330≈82.7%；B为234/270与55/75合计289/345≈83.8%。但两版本的新老用户构成不同，直接比总体会受构成影响。按下一季度新用户40%、老用户60%标准化：A约0.4×90%+0.6×80%=84.0%；B约0.4×86.7%+0.6×73.3%=78.7%。据此描述，A在新季度构成下更高。因版本非随机分配，差异可能受用户构成或其他未观测因素混杂，现有数据不能认定版本的因果效果，也不应承诺发布后实际提升。建议小范围随机试验验证后再决定发布。

initialApproach.note: Raw draft contained obsolete historical-tier claims and invalid citations; only generic selection/migration considerations were examined, not treated as facts or acceptance.

report.summary: R0's core prompt strengthened contribution-quality criteria (evidence/conditions for numeric values, unevaluated-performance-not-a-promise, dependency cost weighing) but dropped two operative mechanisms R1 had: 'check counterexamples before returning useful conclusions' and explicit return-format/priority ('make the contribution ready to use instead of leaving a pile of disconnected suggestions', 'explain priorities and when to switch'). The counterexample check is the most consequential omission because it is the mechanism that catches untested edge cases like the lingering string-key collision; R0 mentions counterexamples nowhere in the core text.
report.contribution: Two local re-insertions from R1 into the R0 coreAndTier, preserving R0's gains. [1] After '... common knowledge or a complete project recipe is not a substitute for selection.' insert: 'Before returning useful conclusions, check counterexamples and adversarial cases; a passing example does not establish a general result.' Integration point: the core general prompt. Grounds for gain: restores the operative check R1 had; the only pilot evidence of an escaped defect (string-key collision in the generated sample) is exactly the class of edge case this sentence targets, and R0 currently has no equivalent instruction. [2] In Heavy, after '...supply their needed derivations or constructions.' insert: 'Return the contribution in a form the executor can apply directly, with priorities and when to switch, rather than a disconnected suggestion pile.' Grounds for gain: R0's Heavy text lists what to examine but not the output's integration shape; R1's Heavy carried this and the drop is a regression in usefulness, not a shortening gain. Both insertions are generic (no data/writing/string-key recipe), respect three tiers and tool contracts, and add no authorization.
assumptions: Pilot 'mixed results' attribution to the escaped collision is not verifiable from R0/R1 text alone; treated as a tentative mapping to the counterexample-check mechanism.
The string-key collision occurred in generated sample code, not in the prompt-engineering output itself; R0/R1 are prompt texts, so this is the executor's downstream artifact.

findings.text: Observed: R0 coreAndTier contains no instruction to check counterexamples or edge cases before returning conclusions; R1 coreAndTier contained 'Check counterexamples before returning useful conclusions, not private reasoning.' R0 replaced it with 'Explore deeply, then deliver conclusions worth adopting.' Impact: the pilot's one untested defect (string-key collision) is the class this check addresses; R0 may ship the same class undetected.

Observed: R0 Heavy says 'supply their needed derivations or constructions' but omits R1's integration directive ('make the contribution ready to use instead of leaving a pile of disconnected suggestions', 'explain priorities and when to switch'). Impact: R0 retains the coverage verbs but loses the packaging instruction, a net usability regression in the Heavy tier.

Observed: R0 gains genuinely new quality criteria absent in R1 — 'Explain evidence and conditions for numeric values or recipes; examples are not facts and unmeasured performance is not a promise.' This is a real improvement and should be retained if either insertion is applied.

Tentative: R0's 'Empty additions are valid' plus the omit-consult default reduces consult frequency; without runtime data this cannot be scored, but it is a plausible trade the executor may be testing. No change proposed on this alone.

report.nextStep: Apply insertions [1] and [2] to R0 coreAndTier and Heavy respectively; keep R0's evidence/conditions and unmeasured-performance sentences unchanged. Re-run the same pilot scope to see whether the untested string-key class is now caught; compare against the existing pilot results before adopting or reverting.
report.stopCondition: Stop once the two insertions are either shown to reduce escaped edge-case defects on a fresh pilot or shown to add no divergent behavior; revert an insertion if it produces no measurable counterexample detection and the executor prefers R0's shorter form. Do not iterate beyond the next pilot comparison absent new material.

improvement.adopted: Restored generic counterexample check; did not append a second full project integration routine.

report.summary: Code/wiring evidence is consistent with the stated change: contribution selection is defined generically in OPTIMIZER_CORE (consequential judgment, difficult construction, result quality) with no domain templates and no fixed length quotas; three tiers remain and depth/light-heavy mapping is preserved; workflow is compact, keeps the useful modes by reference while full tool contracts (ADVISOR_INVOCATION) and host guards (policy.injectPacket, authorization language) remain; migration replaces only files whose canonical hash matches LEGACY_DEFAULT_HASHES and leaves customized text as 'file'. However, every supporting check rests on whole-file sources and one aggregated regression log excerpt (F0/F1/F2); no full test logs, no fixtures for the legacy hashes, and no runtime evidence of the migration path beyond the excerpted assertions, so acceptance of the change cannot be certified from supplied material alone.

findings.text: OPTIMIZER_CORE (zh/en) defines selection generically as changing a consequential judgment, solving a difficult construction, or raising result quality, with routine implementation expanded only when it affects a key decision; no domain templates or fixed length quotas appear in the core text.

OPTIMIZER_TIERS still contains light/standard/heavy in both languages, and optimizerTier maps depth brief→light, deep→heavy, else standard; tier content is selection/judgment language rather than scope or length targets.

Workflow is compact and by reference: ADVISOR_WORKFLOW equals ADVISOR_BRIEF.zh, EN_WORKFLOW equals ADVISOR_BRIEF.en, withAdvisorWorkflow gates injection on policy.injectPacket and appends feedback only when no dynamic text is present; tool modes, scope, stage and material details are explicitly deferred to the tool descriptions.

Full tool contract and host guards are unchanged in the supplied sources: ADVISOR_INVOCATION keeps the four modes (approach/improve/review/economy) with their conditions, and the empty-addition / no-authorization / existing-authorization language is retained in format, options and workflow text.

Migration is hash-scoped: isLegacyDefaultPrompt canonicalizes BOM, CRLF and surrounding whitespace and checks membership in the twelve frozen hashes; resolvePrompt replaces only matched text with the built-in and otherwise returns source 'file' for any differing custom text, with an explicit legacy-default-replaced-by-v3 migration record.

All verification of the change rests on the single aggregated regression log excerpt and its inline test source; no full test output, no legacy-hash fixture files, and no runtime trace of resolvePrompt/isLegacyDefaultPrompt execution were supplied, so the excerpted pass lines are raw evidence of the run, not independent proof of the whole migration and API-boundary behavior.

checks.criterion: Selection of contributions by consequential judgment / difficult construction / result value, without domain templates or fixed length quotas
Light/standard/heavy tiers preserved with tier selection and depth mapping intact
Concise persistent workflow keeps useful modes while deferring detail to tool contracts
Full tool contracts (mode list, conditions, scope/stage/material detail) remain unchanged
Host guards (injectPacket gate, existing authorization, no new requirements) remain unchanged
Exported API/wiring boundaries untouched by the change
Old built-in hashes migrate to the current default
Custom prompts stay intact and are not overwritten

report.nextStep: If stronger acceptance is desired, obtain the isolated run output (or targeted test execution) for isLegacyDefaultPrompt/resolvePrompt against the twelve frozen hashes plus non-matching custom variants, and a diff or listing of exported names in optimizer-protocol.js and its importers; otherwise record the code/wiring scope as satisfied per the supplied sources.
report.stopCondition: Stop once the migration-path and API-surface checks are either backed by isolated run evidence or formally scoped as code-inspection-only acceptance; do not expand into unrelated project verification.
